stonecutter.title: Stonecutter
lines: Put one block into the input slot and the list of everything it can be cut into appears.
Every recipe takes a single ingredient and gives a fixed amount, so there is no pattern to place.
Stairs, walls and chiseled variants cost one block each, and slabs give two per block.
It can cut stone, cobblestone, deepslate, bricks and copper, and can skip crafting steps.
Stone can be cut straight into cobblestone or stone bricks, which a crafting table cannot do.
stonecutter.notes: Path verified in vanilla: stonecutter_screen_inventory is a child of right_panel (stonecutter_screen.json), same shape as loom 'right_panel/loom_screen_inventory'. Bedrock cut copper: 1 copper block -> 4 cut copper (per wiki); stairs 1 per block; slabs 2 per block. Pack has no stonecutter_screen.json yet and _ui_defs entry would be needed if the pack registers files.

_skipped_shared_or_covered.hopper/dispenser/dropper/crafter: All four are screens inside redstone_screen.json sharing redstone.panel (panel_crafter for crafter). Pack already hooks panel/root_panel/redstone_screen_inventory and panel_crafter/root_panel/redstone_screen_inventory in pack/ui/redstone_screen.json (bc_shared.redstone_content), so they are already covered.
_skipped_shared_or_covered.crafting_table: crafting_screen lives in inventory_screen.json and shares the player_inventory panel with inventory_screen (already hooked with inventory_info). No separate hook point without a binding to tell them apart.
_skipped_shared_or_covered.barrel/shulker_box/ender_chest: barrel_screen and shulker_box_screen inherit chest.small_chest_screen; ender_chest_screen has its own screen but its panel inherits chest.small_chest_panel, so the existing chest_panel hook covers them.
_skipped_shared_or_covered.lectern/composter/other: No dedicated vanilla screen file (lectern uses book_screen.json, not a container; composter has no UI).
